view: Frontal chest radiograph, AP (portable) projection, likely semi-erect/supine; L-marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation (patient right on image left)
technical_quality: Adequate penetration; lung apices and both costophrenic regions included; minimal rotation; low lung volumes (poor inspiration), with the right hemidiaphragm higher than the left; multiple overlying lines/wires partially obscure the upper and left mid chest

devices.type: Implanted venous access port (Port-A-Cath) reservoir with catheter
devices.location: Reservoir over the right anterior upper chest wall (right upper zone); catheter courses via the right neck veins and descends along the right paramediastinal region, tip projected over the lower SVC / cavoatrial junction

devices.type: Second central venous catheter / tunneled line (or external catheter segment) with Y-shaped hub-connector
devices.location: Loops over the left apex / left supraclavicular region, hub-connector projected over the left mid zone at the lateral chest wall; tubing continues inferiorly along the left lateral chest wall and flank
Left lower-lateral chest wall, projected over the left lower zone
Along the left lateral chest wall and both lower flanks (external to the thorax)

devices.type: Small linear metallic density (skin clip or external artifact)
devices.location: Right axillary soft tissue, lateral to the right upper thorax

abnormalities.finding: Diffuse hazy reticulonodular / interstitial-alveolar opacities involving the entire right lung, most dense in the lower zone; right lung less aerated than the left
Confluent airspace opacity at the right base with silhouetting of the right heart border and right hemidiaphragm
Blunting of the right costophrenic angle with basal opacity - possible small right pleural effusion and/or basal atelectasis
Elevated right hemidiaphragm with reduced right lung volume
Patchy reticular / perihilar interstitial opacities in the left mid and lower zones (milder than the right); left costophrenic angle preserved
Mildly prominent cardiomediastinal silhouette (borderline cardiomegaly, limited by AP projection and low lung volumes); trachea midline, no pneumothorax

description_zh: 胸部正面（AP portable）X光，吸氣量不足，右側橫膈較左側抬高。右前上胸壁可見植入式人工血管（Port-A-Cath）儲液槽，導管經右頸靜脈下行，尖端投影於下腔上腔靜脈／心房交界處；另於左上胸及左肺尖可見一條中心靜脈導管／外接管路盤繞，其Y型接頭投影於左中肺野，左下側胸壁並有兩枚心電圖電極片。右肺全肺野瀰漫性網狀結節狀及霧狀浸潤，以右下肺野最為密實並伴右心緣及右橫膈輪廓模糊，右側肋膈角變鈍，疑合併少量肋膜積液或基底肺塌陷；左肺中、下肺野亦見較輕微之網狀／肺門周圍間質性浸潤，左側肋膈角尚清。心縱膈影稍寬（受AP投影影響），氣管居中，未見氣胸或胸管。
